description: UI Polish — Settings page redesign with tabs (General, Notifications, Quick Commands, About), profile edit modal, default profile auto-load, legacy settings purge

userStories.title: Database migration — purge legacy settings
userStories.description: As a developer, I want legacy settings from the old job system removed and app.default_profile_id seeded.
acceptanceCriteria: Create database/migrations/021_purge_and_seed_settings.sql
DELETE FROM settings WHERE key NOT LIKE 'notification.%'
INSERT OR IGNORE app.default_profile_id setting
`cargo test --workspace` passes

userStories.title: Settings page rewrite — tab container
userStories.description: As a user, I want the settings page to have tabs (General, Notifications, Quick Commands, About) with icon-only labels on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete rewrite of ui/src/routes/settings/+page.svelte
Tab bar with 4 tabs using lucide-svelte icons (Settings, Bell, TerminalSquare, Info)
Desktop: icon + text label. Mobile (isMobile()): icon only
activeTab state controls which tab content renders
Placeholder divs for tab content (filled in subsequent stories)
Create ui/src/lib/components/settings/ directory
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 2. Import isMobile from '$lib/state/mobile.svelte.js'. Use flex border-b border-border for tab bar.

userStories.title: General settings tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want a General tab with server URL (Tauri), theme toggle, and default profile selector.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ui/src/lib/components/settings/GeneralSettings.svelte
Server Connection section: shows URL + Change button (Tauri only via isTauri())
Appearance section: Dark/Light toggle buttons using themeState
Data section: default profile dropdown from profilesState.getProfiles()
On profile change: save via settings API set_setting
Wire into settings page replacing General placeholder
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 3. For default profile, use the settings API set_setting() for upsert.

userStories.title: Notification settings tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Notifications tab with rstify config, health check settings, and test button.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ui/src/lib/components/settings/NotificationSettings.svelte
Form fields: enabled toggle, provider dropdown, URL input, token password input, topic (ntfy only), health check toggle, interval dropdown
On mount: load notification.* settings and populate form state
Save button: writes all notification.* keys via settingsState.updateSetting()
Test button: POST /notifications/test with toast feedback
Wire into settings page
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 4. Use extractErrorMessage for errors, toast for feedback.

userStories.title: Quick Commands settings tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want a Quick Commands tab where I can create, edit, and delete saved commands.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ui/src/lib/components/settings/QuickCommandsSettings.svelte
List view: name, command (monospace), category badge, server scope badge, edit/delete buttons
Add Command button opens Modal with: name, command (textarea), category, server scope dropdown
Server dropdown: 'All Servers (global)' + list from serversState.getServers()
Edit opens same modal pre-populated, saves via quickCommandsState.updateCommand()
Delete with confirm(), toast feedback
Empty state message about command palette
Wire into settings page
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 5. Import serversState directly for server dropdown data.

userStories.title: About settings tab
userStories.description: As a user, I want an About tab showing app version, platform, server health, and keyboard shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ui/src/lib/components/settings/AboutSettings.svelte
App info: name, version (0.1.0), platform via getPlatform()
Server health: call get('/health') on mount, show status
Keyboard shortcuts table grouped by category (Tabs, Panes, Layout, Actions)
Wire into settings page
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 6. Use get() from API client for health check. Shortcuts are hardcoded data.

userStories.title: Profile edit modal + sidebar integration
userStories.description: As a user, I want to edit profile metadata (rename, description, set default) from the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ui/src/lib/components/terminal/ProfileEditModal.svelte with name, description, is_default fields
Pre-populate from existing profile data
Save calls profilesState.updateProfile(id, { name, description, is_default })
Add pencil edit icon to sidebar profiles (alongside existing delete)
Add onEditProfile prop to Sidebar, wire in +layout.svelte
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 7. This is metadata-only edit, NOT re-capturing terminal layout.

userStories.title: Default profile auto-load on app start
userStories.description: As a user, I want my default profile to automatically load when I open the app.
acceptanceCriteria: Add $effect in +page.svelte that watches profilesState.getProfiles()
When profiles loaded and tabs.length === 0: find default profile and apply via terminalState.applyProfile()
Fallback: if no default profile, create empty tab (existing behavior)
Remove the manual initial tab creation from onMount, move to $effect
`cd ui && npm run check && npm run build` passes
userStories.notes: See plan Task 8. Import profilesState and LayoutMode. The $effect avoids the async race condition.
